review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner; self-review, not independent approval
review.decision: Implement visible read retry, compact grouped process display and stable echo handoff
review.notes: User screenshot reports weak/no-op Retry, identical chain rows with verbose replay caveat, long awaiting-confirmation and jumping duplicate echo. Producer already tracks unique PID with repeated-incarnation validation; identical sanitized nodes are distinct processes, so group count rather than claim duplicate source. Presentation only: no raw argv or authority/privacy changes. Read lanes stay bounded, explicit retry invalidates stale lane/ETag; no model-mutation retry. Echo uses existing attachment-aware identity+new occurrence baseline, stable source/optimistic key, never receipt-only execution proof; no rapid polling or fake timing. Schema/installed180 sources unchanged. All UI tests synthetic; no real screen/TCC/session send. Design committed before test edits; preserve meaningful older identity/permission guards and re-review copy expectations.
